title: fix(plugin-security): an organization administrator's grant that names a package is judged on that holder alone (ADR-0150 D8 R1)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgV8G2fKKL5LFcnXqFgAyXLF)_

epic:#31527#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYo8VDvZo5uZQdPzXr

## 维护者速读

1. 场景：两个应用包都带同名权限集，组织管理员在授予时指定其中一个包，授给本组织的用户。
2. 问题：组织边界检查先按指定的包判，又按"只看名字"再判一次；名字有两个持有者时第二次必然拒绝，于是这类授予一律 403。
3. 第二次判断的前提（写入时按名字改写包列）已被 #32164 去掉：指定的包要么原样保存，要么直接 409 拒绝。
4. 修复后：指定了包，就只判那个包的权限集；没指定包，照旧按名字判（两个持有者时拒绝，并列出两者）。
5. 放宽一格：指定边界内持有者 403 → 准入。指定边界外持有者、不指定包、指定非持有者、单持有者、删除授予，全部不变。
6. 目前环境里一个名字还注册不了第二个持有者（要等 #31698 PR-2），所以今天没有环境的答案会变；这是给 PR-2 铺路。

Fixes #32538

Clause-②: yes (widening) — one over-refusal lifted: an organization administrator naming the in-boundary holder of a two-holder set, FROM 403 TO admitted.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no authorable key, door or documented answer changes; the moved answer is reachable only once a second holder is registrable (#31698 PR-2).

## What changed

- **`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.ts`** (the grant leg of `organizationAdminFailure`, +9/−5): the organization-boundary check of a `sys_user_permission_set` row judges the holder the row names in `permission_set_package` and nothing else. The second leg — `organizationBoundaryFailure(setName)` with no package, run for an insert that named a package — is removed, with the comment that justified it ("the write seam re-stamps the column from the name with no caller"). Since #32164 the seam (`stored-permission-set-package-stamp.ts`) keeps a named package that holds the name and refuses one that does not (`409 not-held-by-qualifier`), at any holder count, and never re-stamps it. A column naming no holder of the name reads as no package (`createSecurityCatalogReader`'s stale-column arm), so the one leg still judges exactly the set the reader will resolve; a grant naming no package is judged by its name, as before.
- Source: #32164 P2 (PR #32306) contract review 6813617327, ④ should-fix 4.

## FROM → TO (every moved answer)

Two-holder stand-in registry: `shared_reader` held by `com.acme.crm` (inside the boundary) and `com.acme.hr` (fails condition (a): `objects['*'].viewAllRecords`). Both organization-administrator variants (walled `organization_admin`, wall-less `organization_admin_no_bypass`).

| Organization administrator's grant (insert) | FROM (main 6bbdf301) | TO | Clause-② arm | Pin |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| two holders, in-boundary holder `com.acme.crm` named | 403 PERMISSION_DENIED — "…cannot resolve…: held by 2 packages … names no package: package "com.acme.crm"; package "com.acme.hr"" | admitted; row keeps `permission_set_package: com.acme.crm`, lands in `org_a` | yes (widening) | `two holders, the in-boundary holder named…` |
| two holders, out-of-boundary holder `com.acme.hr` named | 403, condition (a) | unchanged | — | `two holders, the holder outside the boundary named…` |
| two holders, no package named | 403, names both holders | unchanged | — | `two holders, no package named…` |
| two holders, a package holding neither named | 403, names both holders (stale column reads as no package) | unchanged | — | `two holders, a package that holds neither named…` |
| one holder (inside / outside), named or not | admitted / 403 condition (a) | unchanged | — | `CONTROL: one holder…` |
| removal of a stored grant naming either holder | judged on the row's holder (the removed leg never ran for a removal) | unchanged | — | `CONTROL: the removal of a stored grant…` |

Positions (`sys_user_position`) and the scoped-delegate leg (`directGrantSet`) are not touched.

## Tests

- New top-level describe `[ADR-0150 D8 R1, #32538] an organization administrator's grant naming a package is judged on that holder alone` in the package's shared `delegated-admin-gate.test.ts`: 6 pins × 2 administrator variants = 12. The stand-in registry is bound with `createSecurityCatalogReader` over `makeOrganizationHarness`'s engine (the shape `grant-permission-set-package.test.ts` uses), because a real registry refuses a second holder until #31698 PR-2.
- **Red on main** (6bbdf301 + pins): 2 failed | 10 passed — the in-boundary-named pin, both variants, refused with the bare-name message.
- **Ablation** (fix reverted on the final tree, pins kept): the same 2 red; restored → green.
- `delegated-admin-gate.test.ts`: 202/202. `@objectstack/plugin-security` suite and typecheck: see Gates.

## Gates

- `dispatch-gates --commands` on 5c17f8895: 66 derived families, all run; `--ran` reconcile: 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n` first exited 3 on prerequisites — the pinned commit, a full build — and were re-run after a full non-docs build, 119/119: exit 0).
- `pnpm lint` exit 0. `@objectstack/plugin-security` `typecheck` exit 0 (incl. `check:test-typecheck`); suite 262 files, 6491 passed | 45 skipped.
- Merged `origin/main` (5c0333491, 6 commits, none touching `plugin-security` or `core/src/security`): `delegated-admin-gate.test.ts` 202/202.
- Dogfood battery: not owed (`Clause-②: yes (widening)`, no BREAKING, no narrowing arm).

## Shared files with seat 1's chain

`git diff --stat origin/main...<branch>` for `claude/project-thread-3giljf`, `wqgmuu`, `du44hj`, `phk4r9` against this PR's three files: no shared file.

## Acceptance notes

- Acceptance list of the card: named package ⇒ that holder only, bare-name leg only when none named ✔; comment matches the seam after #32306 ✔; pins (two-holder stand-in, in-boundary admitted, out-of-boundary refused, none named refused, one-holder CONTROL) ✔; `Clause-②:` measured and declared ✔.
- Epic red lines: resolution not loosened (the gate reads the same resolver the reader reads; a name two holders hold with no package is still refused, naming both); bare names with one holder unchanged (CONTROL); additive and independently releasable.
- Out of scope, reported to the seat (not changed here): the boundary refusal's sentence for a direct grant still reads "which the position cannot resolve"; and the scoped-delegate leg (`directGrantSet`) still computes a re-stamped holder for an insert that names a package, whose comment carries the same pre-#32164 premise.
